The role requires deep expertise in PIM tools, data modeling, and multi\-channel product syndication.

* Implement and maintain PIM platforms (Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify) including workflows, rules, and data quality checks.

* Perform code and configuration reviews and mentor junior developers.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Data Stewards, Architects, QA, and business stakeholders in Agile environments.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one PIM platform: Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify, or equivalent.
* Deep understanding of product data modeling — attribute families, completeness metrics, variant/SKU hierarchies, and category trees.
* Experience building PIM\-to\-Commerce integrations (Adobe Commerce, VTEX, Salesforce Commerce, etc.).
* Proficiency with REST / GraphQL APIs for data ingestion and syndication.
* Experience with ERP integration (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) for pricing, inventory, and product master data.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with catalog APIs or Adobe Commerce catalog modules.
* Knowledge of DAM systems and media asset enrichment workflows.
* Familiarity with ETL tools (MuleSoft, Boomi).
* Understanding of B2B catalog scenarios: customer\-specific pricing, entitlements, and product visibility rules.
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and MDM concepts.

* Ownership of product data quality and enrichment workflows end\-to\-end.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Super Smelters Limited is one of India’s leading steel manufacturers with diversified interests across metals, mining, and power. The company has a strong presence in both domestic and international markets, serving customers throughout India and exporting to key global destinations. It is committed to sustainability and environmentally responsible manufacturing, integrating advanced production technologies with innovative practices. With a focus on quality and operational excellence, Super Smelters Limited contributes to infrastructure and industrial development while creating long\-term value for stakeholders and the environment.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Salesforce Developer role based in Kolkata. The Salesforce Developer will design, develop, test, and deploy customized solutions on the Salesforce platform to support business processes across manufacturing, supply chain, and corporate functions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include building and maintaining Lightning Web Components, Visualforce pages, and custom integrations, as well as configuring and optimizing Salesforce applications. The role involves collaborating with business and IT teams to gather requirements, translating them into technical specifications, and ensuring data integrity, performance, and security. The developer will also support ongoing administration tasks, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to continuous improvement of the CRM ecosystem.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Proficiency in Salesforce.com Development, including Apex, triggers, and custom objects.
* Hands\-on experience with Lightning Web Components and Visualforce Pages for UI and component development.
* Strong Salesforce.com Administration skills, including configuration, workflows, approvals, and security settings.
* Solid understanding of core Salesforce.com platform capabilities and best practices.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems via APIs and middleware tools.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer I, Administrator) are highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable code, document solutions clearly, and work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and capacity to work on\-site in a fast\-paced industrial environment.
